function.name: weather_forecast_get

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t tell you the exact minute right now.  
If you know the current Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), you can convert it to New York time by subtracting 4 hours (during daylight‑saving time, which is in effect on June 29).  

For example, if it’s 14:00 UTC, it would be 10:00 AM in New York.
